<!-- pr-reviewer: b71f2e5941f1dea80c05896362d8596500025fd8 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The new text agrees with the existing Bake coordinate handling. The selector still uses the undoable `SetPostOptions` command.

Local results against upstream main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`:

- The trial merge was clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- The app `wcs_rotation_control` test build passed. All 5 tests passed.
- All 5 post `wcs_rotate` tests passed. These include Bake moves, arcs, and drilling coordinates.
- The UI library suite passed from `crates/ui`: 1053 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Clippy passed for all targets of `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui`, and `camcraft-post`, with `-D warnings`.
- The quick gate plan and `git diff --check upstream/main` passed. The full quick gate did not run in this review.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_options.rs:195` and `crates/app/src/schema.rs:635`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the changed Bake selection label and the tooltip. The body currently has no screenshots. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body. Do not commit them to this PR branch.

Notes:

- This diff changes wording and tests. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge/collision checks. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. I did not repeat the author's label mutation.
- No G-code or CL goldens changed. No snapshot PNGs changed.
- The inherited compile-cache wrapper was disabled for the local checks. No GitHub runner was used.
- The PR remains a draft because the required screenshots are missing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added before/after screenshots of the Bake selection label and its tooltip to the PR body. The four PNGs are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, at commit `6032958a8cf59d38dcb2d29dfc91b7dfa827ac37`.

The captures render the actual document Post page with egui_kittest. Both capture runs assert the selected Bake value and the full tooltip text. The body image-link pin passed. Removing any one of the four links made it fail; restoring the links made it pass. All four published PNGs were downloaded and matched the local captures.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 46 steps. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. The final checks used the PR's own assets and source after clearing shared-build contamination from the before capture.

PR head: `b71f2e5941f1dea80c05896362d8596500025fd8` (unchanged). The normal push reported up to date. No source change was requested or committed. The PR remains a draft, and its labels are unchanged.

Please re-review the screenshot finding on this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b71f2e5941f1dea80c05896362d8596500025fd8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The author supplied new screenshot evidence after the earlier review. The PR head did not change. I checked the evidence and repeated the local checks.

The earlier screenshot request is complete. I withdraw that request from my earlier review on this head.

- All four image links in the PR body load. I inspected the before and after images for the Bake label and tooltip.
- The after images show the table-coordinate label and the warning against entering a rotation on the control.
- The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `6032958a8cf59d38dcb2d29dfc91b7dfa827ac37`. This PR changes no PNG files.
- The documentation agrees with the existing Bake coordinate handling. The selector still uses the undoable `SetPostOptions` command.

Local results against upstream main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`:

- The trial merge was clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- App `wcs_rotation_control`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- Post `wcs_rotate`: 5 passed, 0 failed. These tests cover Bake moves, arcs, and drilling coordinates.
- UI library tests, run from `crates/ui`: 1053 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. The changed WCS rotation undo test passed.
- Clippy passed for all targets of `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui`, and `camcraft-post`, with `-D warnings`.
- The quick gate dry-run produced 46 planned steps. The full quick gate did not run in this review.
- `git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- This diff changes wording and tests. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge/collision checks. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. I did not repeat the author's mutation.
- No G-code or CL goldens changed. No snapshot PNGs changed.
- All checks ran locally in the isolated review worktree. The inherited compile-cache wrapper was disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
